title: Resonance of Three Realms
next_chapter_hook: The guidance of the Three Realms' will thundered like a lightning strike—the key to the Fourth Path lay in the hands of Chen Ling, missing for years. When the mortals' will connected with Chen Ji's Mental Sea, that blurry figure finally became clear...

text.content: The First Observer's will surged like a vast sea, carrying the weight of billions of years, pressing so heavily upon Chen Ji's Mental Sea that it nearly shattered. He saw—saw how the First Observer left the first crack upon Heaven's chessboard, how he transformed himself into the Dao, branding his existence into the river of fate flowing through all beings of the Three Realms. 'An Observer is not a mere observer,' that will echoed within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, 'but a bearer. A bearer of the Three Realms' suffering, of all beings' sorrows and joys, of Heaven's gaps—Who are you? Who are you willing to become?'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's voice pierced through the Void, carrying an unprecedented gravity: 'Chen Ji, the dimensional invaders' aura is approaching. Within three breaths, they will lock onto your position. I can only mask the Tianji Record's aura, not the entire ritual—Are you certain you wish to continue?' Her Demonic Path mist flowed like ink around Chen Ji, forming a protective layer, yet unable to conceal the ritual's light that was about to surge skyward.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. Those once meek and peaceful眼眸 now burned with flames capable of incinerating the entire heavens. The Three Realms Resonance ritual—this was the supreme taboo, untouched since antiquity. It required not merely Heavenly Fate points, but using one's own being as a conduit, drawing forth the will of all beings across the Three Realms, harnessing that incomprehensibly vast power. The cost? With every resonance, the joys, sorrows, loves, hates, and passions of the Three Realms' beings would be carved into the depths of his soul, until they drowned him completely.

dialogue.content: 'Continue.' Chen Ji uttered two words, his voice soft yet carrying unmistakable resolve. He rose slowly, his tattered servant robe rustling without wind, as his fingertips began sketching the Three Realms Resonance formation runes. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently within his Mental Sea, and Mo Xiansheng's shattered soul within its first page rippled intensely, as if sensing an imminent catastrophic upheaval.

text.content: The moment the first formation rune descended, the world suddenly lost all color. Countless points of light rose from every corner of the Three Realms—those were the wills of all beings, the threads of fate invisible and intangible to mortals. They came from the mundane world, from cultivators' obsessions, from the wildness of demons and monsters, from the crevices of Heaven's Mandate. Thousands of light points converged into a river, like the Milky Way reversed, enveloping Chen Ji entirely. The sheer immensity, purity, and tragic grandeur of that power made Chen Ji's heart nearly cease beating.

dialogue.content: A cold voice descended from beyond the Nine Heavens, carrying the Heaven's Mandate's unique arrogance and disdain: 'Chen Ji, do you think by touching the First Observer's remnant soul, you can contend against Heaven's Mandate? Laughable. The Three Realms are merely a pasture I raise, mortals' will merely lambs awaiting slaughter—do you summon them to let these lambs die in your stead?' The Heaven's Eye's pressure bore down like mountains collapsing, countless light points trembled and scattered beneath the pressure, yet more light points surged forward to meet it.

text.content: A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips, that mockery carrying rage suppressed for far too long. He thought of those contemptuous gazes in the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters, the dignity trampled upon like waste, the helpless despair when his sister Chen Ling vanished and he could do nothing. Heaven's Mandate? Hmph, have you lofty beings ever glanced down at the ants beneath your feet? Today, I, Chen Ji, shall let the beings of the Three Realms show you—ant strength can also shake heaven!

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's pupils contracted sharply. She watched a jet-black rift tear open in the Void—the dimensional invaders had arrived. Those existences belonging to neither the Three Realms nor the Heaven's Mandate, like famished beasts scenting blood, furiously hurled themselves toward the Three Realms Resonance ritual. 'Chen Ji!' Ye Qing barked, her Demonic Path mist unfurling at full strength, yet shattered the instant it met those invaders' auras. What came was not one or two, but an entire dimensional army's advance contingent!

text.content: The vanguard of the dimensional invaders was a beast formed entirely of twisted spacetime, its form obscuring half the sky. Countless tentacles extended toward those gathering mortal light points. Each light point touched meant a mortal's will being devoured, digested, converted into nourishment for the invaders. The Heaven's Eye coldly smiled above the Nine Heavens, seemingly savoring this feast of slaughter. 'See, Chen Ji? Your compassion only makes them die faster.'

choice.prompt: The Three Realms' beings trembled beneath the dual oppression of Heaven's Mandate and the invaders. Chen Ji needed to make a choice—how would he respond to this apocalyptic catastrophe?

choices.text: Use oneself as bait, drawing away the dimensional invaders
choices.description: Chen Ji actively released his Heavenly Fate aura to its extreme, attracting all the invaders' firepower, buying time for the Three Realms' beings to gather. This was the most direct form of confrontation, but would expose Chen Ji to the full assault of the dimensional army.
choices.visible_reward: The Three Realms' mortal will fully凝聚, the dimensional invaders briefly suppressed
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ji will endure the full blow from the dimensional invaders' vanguard

text.content: Chen Ji laughed. That smile carried a near-mad resolve as he abruptly released his entire Heavenly Fate aura without reservation, like igniting a blinding beacon in the darkness. 'Come, then!' He spread his arms wide. The Tianji Record Fragment burned furiously in his Mental Sea, its text transforming into a golden torrent flooding his四肢百骸. The power was so violent it nearly destroyed all his meridians, yet also pushed his momentum to an unprecedented pinnacle.

choices.text: Borrow the momentum of the Three Realms, awaken the dormant ancient will
choices.description: Chen Ji chose not to face the attack head-on, but instead to guide the Three Realms Resonance's power, awakening those ancient existences that slumbered since the ancient wars. This required a more complex ritual, but might summon unexpected allies.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 20 Heavenly Fate points as ritual catalyst
choices.visible_reward: Summon the ancient guardians, the Three Realms' will manifests for the first time
choices.risk_hint: The ritual process may be interrupted by the invaders

text.content: Chen Ji formed seals with both hands, lowly chanting: 'Three Realms as guide, mortal will—summon!' He was not summoning power, but awakening memories. Those heroic spirits who fell protecting the Three Realms in the ancient wars, those ancient powerhouses whose existence was erased by Heaven's Mandate, those taboo existences meant to sleep forever—they heard Chen Ji's summons. Not because of his power, but because of his choice.

choices.text: Use the Three Realms Resonance to backlash against Heaven's Mandate, sacrificing part of one's Heavenly Fate
choices.description: Chen Ji channeled the power of Three Realms resonance toward the Heavenly Dao origin, opposing the Heavenly Dao's will with the will of all beings. But this would enrage the Heavenly Dao and invite even more furious retaliation.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming 40 points of Heavenly Fate, may trigger Heavenly Dao backlash
choices.visible_reward: The Heavenly Dao origin trembles, the Dimension Invaders are forced to retreat
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao's retaliation may fall upon those Chen Ji cares most about

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze suddenly turned ice-cold as an abyss, he abruptly turned around, channeling the full power of Three Realms resonance toward the lofty existence above the nine heavens. "You say all beings are lambs?" His voice was like the cold ice of the nine netherworlds, "Then today I shall make these lambs bite through your throat!" The Tianji Record bloomed with unprecedented radiance at this moment, that was not golden light, but the bloody firmament condensed from the grief and righteous fury of all beings!

The vanguard of the Dimension Invaders—the beast formed from twisted spacetime—finally locked onto Chen Ji's position. It let out a roar that shattered mountains and rivers, countless tentacles rushing toward Chen Ji like a violent storm. Those tentacles were covered with vortices that devoured will, once touched, one would be pulled into endless dimensional gaps, never to be reborn. Ye Qing attempted to block with demonic path mist, yet was struck directly by a tentacle and sent flying, spitting blood. "Chen Ji! Quick, think of something!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood proudly at the center of the tentacle storm, his tattered servant robe torn by the howling wind, yet a faint smile appeared on his face. That smile was so glaring, so unforgivable in the eyes of the Heavenly Dao's Eye. "What are you laughing at?" The Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice carried a trace of imperceptible confusion. "I laugh at your stupidity." Chen Ji's voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached every being's ears, "You think I released my Heavenly Fate aura to seek death? You're wrong—I was guiding them toward a direction."

text.content: Before his words even finished, those scattered lights of all beings suddenly changed. They no longer blindly crashed against the Heavenly Dao's pressure, but gathered toward Chen Ji like rivers flowing to the sea. Not dozens, not hundreds, but—infinite number. Those lights came from every corner of the three realms, from every life that had existed, was existing, and would exist. They condensed into a massive vortex around Chen Ji, completely blocking the Dimension Invaders' tentacles.

choice.prompt: The will of all beings across the three realms has gathered, Chen Ji is about to trigger the core of Three Realms resonance—but the most crucial step of the ritual requires him to make a final choice

choices.text: Release the will of all beings, form the Shield of Three Realms
choices.description: Transform the power of all beings into a shield, warding off the Dimension Invaders while also sealing the Heavenly Dao's Eye outside. This is a defensive stance, able to preserve current achievements but unable to counterattack.
choices.visible_reward: The Dimension Invaders are completely blocked, the Heavenly Dao's Eye temporarily retreats
choices.risk_hint: The will of all beings requires a long time to recover after consumption

text.content: Chen Ji pushed both hands outward, quietly chanting: "Three realms as shield, all beings as spear—combine!" Those gathered lights instantly solidified into a massive wall spanning heaven and earth, composed of countless tiny wills, each will carrying its unique obsession, emotion, and memories. The Dimension Invaders' tentacles colliding with this wall produced ear-piercing shrieks, like snow poured on boiling oil,crazed地消融着.

choices.text: Transform the will of all beings into a blade, piercing directly into the dimensional gap
choices.description: Not defense but offense, condensing the will of all beings across the three realms into a divine weapon capable of tearing dimensional barriers. This will directly strike the Dimension Invaders' origin, but the risk is extremely high.
choices.visible_reward: The Dimension Invaders' vanguard is completely destroyed, the invasion channel is sealed
choices.risk_hint: The attack may accidentally injure beings across the three realms

text.content: Chen Ji's hands forcefully closed, letting out a thunderous roar: "Power of all beings—condense!" Those infinite lights rapidly gathered before him, not into a shield, but into a crystal-clear longsword. Countless names of beings from the three realms, their joys and sorrows, separations and reunions, their unwilling fates to be manipulated were inscribed on the sword's body.

Just as the two forces were about to collide, an unprecedented voice sounded in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. That voice was ancient and majestic, surpassing the Heavenly Dao's pressure and dimensional obstruction, as if it had existed since the birth of the three realms. "Descendant of the Observer..." the voice slowly spoke, each word causing Chen Ji's soul to tremble, "You have summoned me, awakened the sleeping will. Now, what will you do with this power?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji felt the strength of that will, a kind of existence that transcended his cognitive scope. The first Observer's remnant soul was merely a firefly before the moon compared to this will. "Who are you?" Chen Ji asked in his heart. "I am the three realms," the voice calmly replied, "the first will bred by this heaven and earth from chaos, existing even before the birth of the Heavenly Dao—the origin of the three realms."

text.content: The Three Realms Origin! Chen Ji's heart suddenly tightened. He finally understood the first Observer's hint—the fourth path was not about observation or resistance, but communication. The communication was not with some Heavenly Dao or Dimension Invaders, but with the three realms themselves! The most primitive, pure, and powerful will of this heaven and earth! It had been sleeping within the fate of all beings, waiting for a special enough opportunity to be awakened.

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Dao's Eye panicked completely at this moment. That ancient voice was a thousand times, ten thousand times more terrifying to it than any enemy. "Impossible!" its voice carried trembling for the first time, "The origin of the three realms fell into a deep sleep when the world was created, how could you possibly awaken it?!" Chen Ji slowly raised his head, staring directly at the giant eye above the nine heavens, a mocking arc curling at the corner of his mouth: "Because I represent all beings. And all beings, were never ants."

text.content: The voice of the Three Realms Origin sounded again, carrying a sigh almost akin to satisfaction: "For billions of years, countless living beings have been born, grown, and perished within my embrace. Most of them were like fleeting clouds, coming and going without leaving a trace. But some exist..." The voice paused. "They chose to bear the weight of all beings, to speak for the silent ones. Chen Ji, you are the first human to actively gather the will of all beings within yourself."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji quietly sensed the majestic will in his Mental Sea, feeling no fear, only an unprecedented tranquility. "Three Realms Origin, I have a question," he said in his heart. "Ask," the ancient voice responded. "If I wish to open the fourth path—one that requires no observation, no struggle, and no compromise—what do I need?" The Three Realms Origin fell silent for a moment, that silence seemingly spanning eons.

text.content: When the Three Realms Origin spoke again, its voice carried an indescribable complexity: "The fourth path transcends the barrier between observer and observed, allowing the beings of the Three Realms to truly become masters of their own fate. This path... requires two people to take the step simultaneously." Two people? Chen Ji's heart stirred. "The first is you, Chen Ji," the Three Realms Origin said slowly. "The second... is a blood-related existence. She is called the 'Heavenly Fate Lock-Key,' the forbidden land key coveted simultaneously by dimensions and the Heavenly Way."

dialogue.content: Chen Ling! Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, those three characters exploding like thunder in his mind. His sister, the girl who had been missing for years, taken by the Holy Sect as the 'Heavenly Fate Lock-Key'—she was actually the key to opening the fourth path? The Three Realms Origin's voice continued: "Her existence disrupts all foresight, because she herself is the greatest variable in the Three Realms. The vague figure you saw in your past prophecies... was her."

text.content: Chen Ji's fist slowly clenched, his knuckles whitening from the force. He thought of those vague prophetic visions, of the violent fluctuations of the Tianji Record every time he tried to see that figure clearly. So that's how it was... from the very beginning, he had been approaching the truth, yet always missing that final layer of paper over the window. Chen Ling, his sister, she had been there all along, waiting for him to find her.

The Three Realms Origin's voice resonated like an ancient bell through Chen Ji's Mental Sea: "The first path, observation, perfects your Tianji Record continuously, making you a more perfect chess piece. The second path, struggle, has you challenge the Heavenly Way with a mortal body, becoming another Heavenly Way. The third path, compromise, has you coexist with the Heavenly Way, becoming part of order. But the fourth path..." The voice paused, "is to let all beings in the Three Realms become chess players, to free you and all beings manipulated by fate."

dialogue.content: Enough!" The Heavenly Eye issued a furious roar, its will transforming into world-destroying thunderbolts that struck toward Chen Ji and the Three Realms Origin. However, those thunderbolts, upon touching the Three Realms Shield, vanished without a trace like mud bulls entering the sea. The Three Realms Origin's voice turned cold as an abyss: "Heavenly Way... do you think this heaven and earth are your private property? The account of billions of years, we settle today." The dimensional invaders' vanguard—that massive beast—began retreating frantically, sensing an existence more terrifying than the Heavenly Way was awakening.

text.content: Chen Ji watched everything unfolding before him, an unspeakable grandeur surging in his heart. The Three Realms Resonance succeeded. Not just simple success, but summoning the Three Realms Origin—an existence that transcended the Heavenly Way and dimensions. The Heavenly Eye before it was so utterly insignificant. "Three Realms Origin..." Chen Ji asked in his heart, "where is Chen Ling now?" The ancient voice fell silent for a moment, then slowly replied: "She is in the deepest part of the Holy Sect, at the edge of the dimensional gap, in a place even the Heavenly Way cannot reach. Go find her, descendant of the observer. Your reunion will begin the prelude to the fourth path."

choice.prompt: The Three Realms Origin has given guidance—Chen Ling is the key to opening the fourth path. But the road to finding Chen Ling is full of unknowns, and Chen Ji needs to decide his next move.

choices.text: Request the Three Realms Origin to guide to Chen Ling's specific location.
choices.description: Using the power of the Three Realms Origin, attempt to break through the dimensional barrier and locate Chen Ling's exact whereabouts. This is the most efficient method, but may consume a large amount of the Three Realms Resonance's achievements.
choices.visible_cost: The Three Realms Resonance ceremony ends prematurely.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a vague sensing of Chen Ling's location.
choices.risk_hint: The Three Realms Origin's power will retreat as a result.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and spoke solemnly in his heart: "Three Realms Origin, please guide me to find Chen Ling." The ancient voice fell silent for a moment, seemingly sensing some distant connection. "Her aura is doubly sealed by dimensions and the Heavenly Way. I can only give you a vague direction—the deepest fissure in the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds." The words fell, and the Three Realms Origin's power began to slowly retreat, the gathered luminous points of beings gradually dispersing.

choices.text: First consolidate the Three Realms Resonance's achievements, improve one's own strength, then search.
choices.description: Not seeking hasty results, first use the Three Realms Origin's power to stabilize the foundation, then use this as capital to search for Chen Ling. This requires more time, but ensures the safety of subsequent actions.
choices.visible_reward: The Three Realms Origin传授 part of its primordial power.

text.content: Chen Ji did not rush to ask further, but quietly sensed the Three Realms Origin's presence. That ancient will seemed to sense his intention and let out a low praise: "What a patient person." The words fell, and a thread of pure power transcending the Heavenly Way flowed into Chen Ji's meridians—this was the Three Realms Origin's gift to him. Though faint, it was enough to give him one more trump card on his future path.

The Three Realms Origin's power began to recede slowly. Those gathered luminous points of beings gradually dispersed like an ebbing tide, but they did not completely leave—each luminous point left a tiny mark in Chen Ji's soul. That was the trust of all beings, the Three Realms' recognition of him. Ye Qing stumbled back to Chen Ji's side, the blood at the corner of her mouth not yet wiped dry, but her eyes gleamed with unprecedented brilliance: "You did it... you really did it!" Her voice carried a tremor, whether from her injuries or excitement.

The dimensional invaders' vanguard—that once-invincible massive beast—was now frantically fleeing toward the dimensional gap. Its body had already begun to disintegrate, because the power of the Three Realms Resonance just now had completely destroyed its foundation for existing in the Three Realms. Chen Ji watched the beast's狼狈 retreat, a faint, cold arc curving at his lips: "Think you can escape?" Before the words finished, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly blazed with dazzling light, locking onto every trace of the beast's escape.

Chen Ji did not pursue—not because he didn't want to, but because the Three Realms Origin's voice rang in his Mental Sea: "Dimensional invaders cannot be completely destroyed by you now. They come from a chaos deeper than the Heavenly Way. But your actions today have torn a rift between the Three Realms and the dimensions—this rift will become the battlefield for the future's decisive battle." Chen Ji silently remembered these words, turning his gaze to the nine heavens above. There, though the Heavenly Eye had retreated, that窥探的意志 never left.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji!" The Heavenly Eye's voice came from beyond the nine heavens, no longer the previous arrogance and disdain, but carrying an incompletely concealed wariness. "Do you think summoning the Three Realms Origin can change anything? You are merely an ant, a pathetic chess piece toyed with by fate. The next time we meet, I will not give you any chance!" The words fell, and that probing will completely disappeared. But Chen Ji knew—this was not an end, but a beginning.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, feeling the faint connection in his Mental Sea. Before the Three Realms Origin fell into a deep slumber, it left one final words: "Observer's Descendant, remember—the Fourth Path requires you both to take the step simultaneously. Your journey is still long, but the end is no longer far away." Chen Ling... He silently念叨着这个名字 in his heart, that blurry figure that had always been impossible to see clearly, becoming crystal clear in his heart for the first time. Wait for me, sister. This time, it will be my turn to save you.

Ye Qing walked to Chen Ji's side, looking at his resolute side profile, and couldn't help but ask: "What's next?" Chen Ji opened his eyes, the light in his gaze brighter than ever before: "To the Holy Sect." His voice was calm yet firm, "To find Chen Ling, to open the Fourth Path." Ye Qing was silent for a moment, then nodded lightly: "I'll accompany you." Chen Ji turned to glance at her, the corner of his mouth slightly rising: "The Holy Sect's Demon Path Saint, accompanying atrash杂役 from Tianqing Sect to storm the dragon's den and tiger's lair? Aren't you afraid of being torn to pieces by your Holy Sect members?"

dialogue.content: Ye Qing snorted coldly, Demon Path mist swirling around her, making her appear even more cold and extraordinary: "The Holy Sect? Hmph, you think I still care about those people who used me as a tool for hundreds of years?" Her gaze fell on Chen Ji, carrying a complex meaning, "Besides, that scene just now... the appearance of the Three Realms Origin has proven your value. Following you might be far more promising than following that bunch of fools at the Holy Sect."

text.content: Chen Ji laughed lightly, saying nothing more. He looked toward the distant horizon—that was the direction of the Holy Sect, the edge of the dimensional gap, the place where his missing sister had been for years. The Tianji Record Fragment glowed faintly in his Mental Sea, and Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul sent a relieved sigh: "Well done, Observer's Descendant. The Three Realms Resonance is only the beginning; the true test still lies ahead. But regardless... you have taken the most crucial step." Chen Ji did not respond, merely calculating each move ahead in his heart.

The aftermath of the Three Realms Resonance Ritual gradually subsided, but that earth-shaking confrontation had spread throughout the three realms. The Eye of Heavenly Dao had retreated, the dimensional invaders had been repelled, and the Three Realms Origin had briefly awakened before falling back into slumber—these news spread like wildfire across the three realms. And the instigator of all this, thetrash杂役 once mocked by everyone, was now leading the Demon Path Saint, embarking on a journey toward the Holy Sect. The wheels of destiny had already begun to turn, and the outline of the Fourth Path was slowly unfolding before Chen Ji...
